body:
## Description
This mod is mainly split from the higher version of the MaLiLib mod. It is a mod of MITE R196, based on Fish Mod Loader 3.2.2 and above. The purpose is to enable developers to easily read and write configuration to json files, and provide a simple screen in the game to adjust the configuration.

## Mods that require ManyLib
A number of MITE client-side mods by other authors that are built around ManyLib. The mod project/description usually indicates which mod(s) are required as a dependency.
